keyTips.text: Survive fragility before level 6 inside experience range on last-hits, refusing risky trades and early deaths.
Keep farming past level 6 instead of forcing fights, since level 11 opens the first major active stretch.
Group at level 16 around objectives and spend Divine Judgment on self or the strongest carry before the fight is lost.

tips.text: Secure last hits with Starfire Spellblade, which costs no mana.
Max Radiant Blast in top lane, poking while collecting minions when the lineup allows.
At level 6, take short trades as opponents step to minions: attack, then reset with E.
Answer slow roam follows by shoving the wave and banking a plate, then recalling for items.
Keep prioritizing farm and experience so level 16 arrives sooner.
After shoving at level 11 or later, take a nearby jungle camp when the route keeps the next wave.
With Teleport ready only, press the side opposite the next major objective.
Scale through levels and items with clean deaths and waves so enemies cannot bend the power curve.
Fight behind the frontline against vulnerable carries instead of starting fights personally.
Expect pain into long-range pressure and repeat knock-ups, preferring limited-range and low-control opponents.
Pair with healing or shielding supports like Lulu, Soraka, or Zilean to reach and survive late fights.

itemization.text: Run Press the Attack with Absorb Life, Legend: Alacrity, and Last Stand plus Celerity and Gathering Storm.
Build Gluttonous Greaves, Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Rabadon's Deathcap, Shadowflame, and Void Staff standard.
Open Statikk Shiv instead on the alternate reworked Statikk path, keeping Nashor's Tooth and later AP items behind it.
Take Flash and Teleport for the top-lane setup.
